blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipality of Narvacan formally opened its first Bagnet Festival on Saturday, Sept. 26, as part of its celebration of Tourism Month. The annual festival seeks to showcase Narvacan’s culture, local products and culinary tradition while promoting unity and community participation, Mayor Edna Cabalo Sanidad said.
